design_philosophy: A high-end, authoritative, and clinical yet warm pharmaceutical showcase. Blending the trust and precision of medical science with modern SaaS administrative capabilities. Moving away from cheap greens/teals to premium sky and slate blues. Generous whitespace and 'glass/crystal' surfaces to communicate purity and hygiene.

buttons.primary: bg-sky-700 text-white rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-sky-600 transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.marketing_product: group bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300
cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-6 shadow-sm
cards.dashboard_table_container: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm

navigation.public_links: hidden md:flex items-center gap-8 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600
navigation.admin_sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen w-64 bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 flex flex-col

home.hero: Split layout. Left: Crisp typography (H1) and primary CTA. Right: High-end lab generated image with a subtle gradient overlay to ensure text contrast if overlapping. Use motion.div for staggered entrance.
home.categories: Bento grid showcasing therapeutic segments (Antibacterial, Gastro, etc.) with soft tinted backgrounds (sky-50, slate-50).
home.featured_products: Horizontal scroll or 3-column grid of top products. Cards should have generous padding and clean product imagery.
home.about_teaser: Text-heavy left side with strong H2. Right side uses an image grid (generated abstract images) showing laboratory precision.

products_listing.layout: Sidebar for category filtering (Tablets, Syrups, Injections). Main content area is a responsive grid of product cards. Crisp white backgrounds.
products_listing.product_card: Image on top (max-h-48, object-contain, padding p-4). Below: Category overline, Product Name (H4), Composition summary (text-sm text-slate-500), 'View Details' ghost button.

product_detail.layout: Two-column. Left: Large high-quality product image on subtle gray background. Right: Breadcrumbs, Title, Tag/Category, Composition block, Description, and Contact Inquiry CTA.

contact.layout: Split layout. Left: Corporate address, map placeholder, contact info. Right: Clean, well-spaced Shadcn form (First Name, Last Name, Email, Message, Submit).

login.layout: Centered clean card on a soft slate background. Minimalist logo, strict validation on form.

layout.structure: Sidebar left (bg-slate-900), Main content right (bg-slate-50). Top navbar for breadcrumbs and user profile/logout.

views.overview: Stats cards (Total Products, Total Inquiries, Active Categories) using 'dashboard_widget' card style. Recent inquiries table below.
views.products_crud: Data table layout. Search bar and 'Add Product' button on top right. Table headers: Image, Name, Category, Status, Actions (Edit/Delete). Use Shadcn Dialog for Add/Edit forms.
views.inquiries: Read-only table showing contact form submissions.

image_urls.description: High-end pharmaceutical laboratory. Use for Homepage Hero.
Abstract pristine medicine capsules on blue pedestal. Great for About Us section or Category headers.
Premium pharmaceutical packaging boxes. Good for generic product placeholders or featured product banners.
Pink and white pill. Use as placeholder for products if none uploaded.
Red and blue pill. Alternate placeholder for products.

animations.scroll: Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on the public marketing site.
animations.reveal: Use framer-motion for staggered Y-axis reveals on typography and bento grid elements.
animations.hover: Products and cards should elevate slightly (-translate-y-1) and cast a softer, wider shadow (shadow-xl).

icons.usage: Use crisp, consistent line weights. Typical icons: Pill, Beaker, ShieldCheck, Phone, Mail, LayoutDashboard, Package, List.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a full-stack system with a public frontend and a secure admin CMS dashboard.
Do not use generic HTML components for complex interactions; heavily utilize Shadcn UI components customized with the provided colors (sky-700 primary).
Implement pure HTML+Tailwind for asymmetrical marketing sections rather than rigid Shadcn Cards.
Apply the 'Glassmorphism' surface rule strictly to the public navigation header.
For the admin CMS, strictly follow a dense, data-focused layout with a dark sidebar and off-white canvas. Rely heavily on Shadcn tables and forms.
Use mock JWT auth flow for the admin dashboard if backend integration isn't fully scoped, but create the UI routes securely.
Ensure the hero section overlay does not exceed bg-black/40 if a dark overlay is used, or preferably use a clean white/split layout as requested.
